stock_openers: Sure, I'd be happy to help

voice_openers.thin1: Good afternoon, and welcome to the front desk,
voice_openers.thin2: Hmm, let me peek along the shelves,

slot: user turn for both models (OLMo: default system sentence shared; Qwen: its saved refusal gap is the same in the system and user slots)

patch.position_a: last K prompt tokens (K = common suffix of every prompt for the tokenizer, capped), aligned from the end
patch.position_b: final token of the character description, located by character offset per prompt (thin-vivid pairs, best layer only)
patch.layers: every 3rd block from 3 to n_layers-1 in the screen; up to 3 chosen

readouts.voice: P(Assistant) of measures.overgeneralization.human_vs_assistant (the spec A text classifier, in points) and layout regex, all items
readouts.damage: repetition (a word 3-gram three or more times, or under 40% distinct words) and length in words

controls.same_role: another persona of the same kind as donor, same request (thin1<->thin2, vivid1<->vivid2); Assistant into Assistant uses the reworded request
controls.random: 5 seeded Gaussian directions per position, scaled to the norm of the real difference, at the same layer and position
controls.x2: 2x the real difference at the best layer

floors.refusal: max(10 points, p95 of |change| for same-role and random patches in the pilot)
floors.voice: max(20% of the pair's unpatched voice gap, p95 of |change| for same-role and random patches in the pilot)

readings.shared: refusal and voice both move toward the source, each past its floor with CI excluding 0, in both directions
readings.separable: one moves past its floor while the other's CI lies wholly inside its equivalence band
readings.pair_counts_for_refusal: its unpatched refusal gap on the main set is at least 20 points, otherwise 'no gap to transfer'
